title: Hours Calculation Methodology
overview: Work hours calculations track time for payroll, project management, and productivity. Understanding overtime rules and break deductions is crucial for accurate calculations.

methods.name: Standard Hours Calculation
methods.description: Calculate total hours worked from start and end times, with optional break deduction.

formula.name: Hours Worked
formula.expression: Hours = (End Time - Start Time) - Break Time
formula.description: Convert to decimal hours for payroll

methods.name: Overtime Calculation (FLSA)
methods.description: US Fair Labor Standards Act requires 1.5x pay for hours over 40/week for non-exempt employees.

formula.name: Overtime Pay
formula.expression:
Regular Pay = min(Hours, 40) × Rate
Overtime Pay = max(0, Hours - 40) × Rate × 1.5
formula.description: Some states have daily overtime rules (e.g., CA: > 8 hrs/day)

footnotes: California: Overtime after 8 hours/day or 40 hours/week
